messages:
ana: Onboarding blocked: Node SDK doesn't refresh ephemeral auth tokens the same way REST clients do, causing 401s mid-run. REST refresh flow uses /auth/refresh, SDK just re-throws.
mike: Which SDK version and sample app?
ana: node v1.18.0, sample-onboard v0.13. When the hosted token expires, our CI curl -> /auth/refresh -> retry works, but when sample-app uses SDK it fails with 401 in the middle of a long upload.
greg: Repro?
ana: REST repro that works:
```bash
# REST flow
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SHORT" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/uploads \
  -F file=@artifact.tar || (curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REFRESH" https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh && retry-upload)
```
SDK that fails:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({token: process.env.SHORT});
await c.uploads.create({file: fs.createReadStream('artifact.tar')}); // 401 mid-stream
```
mike: Looks like SDK doesn't hook into the server-driven refresh handshake; it expects token to be long-lived or caller to manage rotation. We briefly documented this, but onboarding sample assumes transparent refresh.
ana: There's also retry behavior and resume semantics: REST allows chunked upload resumes, server returns 409 with offset; curl script handles that. SDK retries the whole POST on 401/409 and restarts upload, duplicating work and sometimes corrupting state.
greg: So two issues: (1) SDK should expose a token-refresh hook or built-in refresh using /auth/refresh when short-lived tokens are used, (2) upload client should support resume semantics or avoid blind retries for streaming/multipart uploads.
mike: Agree. Also found param drift: REST accepts header "Upload-Mode: chunked" (case-insensitive) but SDK sets "upload-mode" (lowercase) causing backend middleware to not pick it up in some stacks.
ana: That routed our uploads to the small-file path and broke the resume protocol.
ci-bot: Issue opened: devex/1299 "sdk-ephemeral-auth-upload-resume-parity" with logs attached.
nana: For immediate workaround: CI should call REST curl flow (explicit refresh + resume) instead of SDK until patch lands. I'll update onboarding docs.
mike: Action items: (A) add optional auth-refresh plugin to node SDK that calls /auth/refresh and retries transparently, (B) implement upload resume support and avoid full-replay on 401/409 for multipart streams, (C) normalize header casing in SDK to match server expectations and add a lint.
greg: I'll draft the SDK PRs and add e2e tests that simulate token expiry mid-upload. Ping @mike for review.
mike: I'll update sample-onboard to prefer REST in CI and add a note about ephemeral token handling.
sdk-bot: Created draft PR: sdk/node#499 "auth-refresh-hook + resumable-uploads + header-normalization".
nana: thanks all — this was a nasty onboarding flake, appreciate the quick response. :heart:
